name: Aloft Langkawi Pantai Tengah
short_description: Lifestyle Aloft beach hotel on Pantai Tengah near Pantai Cenang, with loft-style sea-view rooms and a rooftop infinity pool overlooking the Andaman Sea.
ai_summary: Aloft Langkawi Pantai Tengah is a 208-room lifestyle beach hotel occupying eight floors on Pantai Tengah, within a short walk of the buzzier Pantai Cenang strip. Reviewers consistently praise the loft-inspired rooms, which feature high ceilings, bold colour palettes, spacious balconies and views of the Andaman Sea, garden or rainforest, plus tech-smart touches, plush platform beds and a complimentary mini-bar. The signature Splash rooftop pool, an infinity pool with whirlpools set in metal birdcage structures, is repeatedly singled out as a superb sunset-viewing spot, and a complimentary pink buggy shuttles guests to the beach. Dining centres on Nook restaurant, with a generous breakfast buffet, and the energetic W XYZ Bar for cocktails and live entertainment. The location earns strong marks for walkability to beach, restaurants and watersports, with the airport roughly 20 minutes away. Watch-outs are operational rather than structural: the breakfast buffet draws crowds at peak times, with slow refills, long egg-station queues and dishes running out, so early arrival is advised. Some guests note thin soundproofing between rooms and hallways, an open-air non-air-conditioned lobby, and limited vegetarian options. As a select-service Aloft there is no executive lounge, but staff are widely described as friendly and helpful, and pricing is considered competitive for a beachfront property.

faqs.question: How far is Aloft Langkawi Pantai Tengah from the airport?
faqs.answer: The hotel sits in Pantai Tengah, roughly 8 kilometres and about a 20-minute drive from Langkawi International Airport (LGK). Grab ride-hailing and hotel transfers are readily available, and the property also runs a complimentary beach buggy for guests heading to the nearby shore.

faqs.question: Does Aloft Langkawi have a beach and a pool?
faqs.answer: It is not directly beachfront but is a short walk from Pantai Tengah beach, with a free pink buggy shuttling guests there. The rooftop Splash area features an infinity pool with whirlpools set in metal birdcage structures, prized for its Andaman Sea sunset views.

faqs.question: Is Aloft Langkawi good for families?
faqs.answer: Yes. Reviewers highlight family-friendly touches including a children's pool, a Camp Aloft setup for kids and spacious rooms with balconies. Its walkable location near Pantai Cenang restaurants, shops and watersports also makes exploring easy, though the breakfast buffet can be crowded at peak family hours.
